name: Bertas im weissen Rössl
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Bertas im weißen Rössl in Reith bei Seefeld**

Discover authentic Tyrolean hospitality in the heart of the Alps. Our cozy restaurant invites you to savor traditional dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**, and fresh mountain cuisine. Enjoy our warm atmosphere, homemade specialties, and a selection of fine local wines and beers.

Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, **Reith bei Seefeld** offers breathtaking views of the **Karzner** and **Seefeld** ski areas. Whether you're here for skiing, hiking, or simply relaxing, our restaurant is the perfect spot to recharge.

Come and experience the true spirit of **Tirol**—where every meal is a celebration of regional flavors and alpine charm. We look forward to welcoming you!
